name: barrier_prop
objective: P(reach the effective profit target on an end-of-day balance BEFORE equity touches the Maximum Loss Limit intraday)
why_this_objective: A prop evaluation IS a barrier problem, so the barrier machinery ports across unchanged. What does not port is the floor: it moves.

The floor ratchets on END-OF-DAY BALANCE, never falls, and LOCKS permanently once it reaches the starting balance. It is nonetheless enforced INTRADAY against equity including unrealized P&L. Modelling only one of those two halves yields a number that looks right and is not.

The consistency rule makes the target endogenous to the path: best_day / total_profit must stay at or below consistency_frac, and breaching it raises the profit target rather than failing the account. So a single outsized session raises the account's own bar. Without this term the search would rank one-lucky-day strategies first, which is precisely the class that cannot be repeated.

verification.why_blocked: profit_target is not printed on any Topstep page read on 2026-08-13; the figure below is from a third-party review site and MUST NOT drive a decision until read off Topstep's own rulebook. load_rules() refuses this file while status is UNVERIFIED.
verification.how_to_clear: Open a Trading Combine 50K page or the Trading Combine Parameters help article, read every field below, set each to VERIFIED with the URL and the date, then set status to VERIFIED.

mll_offset.value_seen: MLL starts $2,000 below the account size; initial MLL $48,000 on a 50K

mll_locks_at_start.value_seen: "rises as your end-of-day balance grows, but never moves down. Once it reaches your starting balance, it locks permanently."

intraday_enforcement.value_seen: "updates at the end of each trading day but is monitored in real time throughout the session. Both realized and unrealized P&L count toward it." Breach triggers immediate market liquidation.

consistency_frac.value_seen: Formula given as "Best Day Profit / Total Profit = Best Day %" at a 50% threshold for the Trading Combine (40% for Express Funded). Prose on the same page also phrases it as 50% of the Profit Target. The FORMULA is taken as operative; the prose reading is the same number only while total profit equals the target.
consistency_frac.resolve_by: Run one evaluation to just above target with a deliberately lopsided best day and read the platform's own Best Day % readout.

consistency_consequence.value_seen: "If it exceeds that, your Profit Target increases. You'll need to earn more to pass." It does NOT fail the account.

min_trading_days.value_seen: "you can pass in as few as two days"
min_trading_days.resolve_by: Confirm whether two days is a stated MINIMUM or merely the observed fastest pass.

profit_target.value_seen: $3,000 on a 50K — from a third-party review site, NOT from Topstep
profit_target.resolve_by: Read it off Topstep's own Trading Combine parameters page or the checkout flow.

daily_loss_limit.value_seen: not found on the pages read; Topstep documents End-of-Day Drawdown as the primary constraint and no separate daily loss limit was located
daily_loss_limit.resolve_by: Confirm whether a daily loss limit exists for the Combine at all. If it does, it is a THIRD barrier and evaluate_prop needs a new term.

day_boundary.falsified_by: a settled Topstep day whose P&L differs from this grouping
day_boundary.why_it_matters: The floor ratchets on the end-of-day balance and the target is tested there, so a wrong boundary moves both barriers. Override trading_day_of before logging any number.

estimator.per_pass: One evaluation attempt = ONE Bernoulli draw. PASS -> 1.0, FAIL -> 0.0, CENSORED -> UNRANKABLE (-1e9).
estimator.aggregation: p_hat over K INDEPENDENT, NON-OVERLAPPING windows with a Wilson 95% interval; censored episodes leave the denominator and are reported separately.

not_modelled_yet: Scaling / trailing rules on the FUNDED account after the Combine is passed — a different objective, and a different version.
Payout policy and the Express Funded 40% consistency objective.
Any daily loss limit, pending the UNKNOWN field above.
change_policy: Never edited by an agent. A change bumps the version and starts a new trial family. Clearing a verification field is a version bump too: results produced under UNVERIFIED rules were judged against a guess.
